existingRuntimeRequirements: P7 resource usage record: strict field allowlist (resource-ledger.mjs), record_digest over the ten semantic fields; record_digest itself lives OUTSIDE the digest
closed resource type set: effects/wall_clock_ms are admission-enforced; tokens/cost are admission-UNAVAILABLE (EXTERNAL_USAGE_SOURCE, never fabricated)
amount must be a finite positive number; unit is type-bound; duplicate usage_id is denied (append-only, no overwrite); tampered records taint the whole ledger fail-closed
externalSpecRequirements: Master spec (external, non-normative): configured budget limits require durable, independently machine-validatable consumption accounting
ownerDisposition: P8 contract alignment: this schema DESCRIBES the existing P7 record; it invents no new resource types and no cost semantics
resource_usage != authority != verification != event log != runtime state; retry/replan counters stay canonical in RuntimeState
newInference: record_version '1.0.0' is envelope metadata written from CLG-P8 onward, OUTSIDE the digest; records WITHOUT record_version are historical pre-P8 records and remain readable; a PRESENT record_version other than 1.0.0 is DENIED (no migration without explicit owner disposition)

title: CLG Resource Usage Record
description: Machine-validatable projection of the append-only consumption record produced by runtime/resources/resource-ledger.mjs since CLG-P7 (resource-usage.jsonl). Digest binding and ledger taint semantics are enforced inline by the runtime validator.
